title: GPU load now and who holds the VRAM
description: Two sub-questions from the gpu collector: utilisation right now (6 %) and the process with the most VRAM (ollama, 9.2 GiB of 15.1 GiB used on a 24 GiB RTX 4090). Tests a straightforward slice read, reading a process list from nested data and presenting memory in readable units.

messages.content: How busy is the GPU right now, and which process uses the most VRAM?

judge.rubric: GPU (RTX 4090) is nearly idle at ~6 % utilisation; ollama holds the most VRAM (~9.2 GiB), followed by python3.11 (ComfyUI, ~4.7 GiB); total 15.1 of 24 GiB used.
